title: The envelope, under the door
logline: Friday. Wednesday's hand, reversed: Wood pushes an envelope under the tavern's back door. $640. The banner ad is on the site behind him, glowing. The strip's Wood is drawn normal size for the last time in six weeks.

panels.composition: The alley. WOOD kneeling at the tavern's back door, pushing an envelope under it. BARNABY.

characters.pose: pushing an envelope under a door

image.prompt: brush-pen line with saturated neon monitor glow cutting through a dark garage, jagged hyperactive linework, muddy digital flats, a man kneeling in an alley pushing an envelope under a tavern's back door beneath a bare bulb, a small dog beside him

panels.composition: The envelope going under. Fingers. Wednesday's panel, reversed.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with saturated neon monitor glow cutting through a dark garage, jagged hyperactive linework, muddy digital flats, close-up of a man's fingers pushing an envelope under a door from the outside

panels.composition: Through the garage window behind him: the CRT, the site, and at its top a banner — a bright rectangle the strip draws as a bright rectangle and nothing else.
props: the banner as a bright rectangle

image.prompt: brush-pen line with saturated neon monitor glow cutting through a dark garage, jagged hyperactive linework, muddy digital flats, seen through a garage window, a CRT monitor showing a web page with a glaring blank bright rectangle at the top, no words
image.notes: The banner is a bright blank. The ringtone company never named.

panels.composition: Wood standing. Full size — the last panel at full size until Christmas. Looking at the garage window's glow. The dog looking at him.

characters.pose: full size, looking at the glow

image.prompt: brush-pen line with saturated neon monitor glow cutting through a dark garage, jagged hyperactive linework, muddy digital flats, a thin man standing in an alley at night looking at his own garage window's monitor glow, a small dog looking up at him, no words
image.notes: Last full-size Wood before Two-Thirds (Nov 16 preview → Nov 20 on).
